name: Miyoo Mini Flip
summary: Miyoo's clamshell-form-factor handheld. spruceOS lists it with 'Stable' support status; Koriki supports Mini Flip models and MinUI lists it as 'Legacy'. No KNULLI image available. Hardware specifications not sourced from verified vendor or community pages at the time of check (2026-10-29).

variants.notes: Clamshell Miyoo device. spruceOS reports 'Stable' compatibility; Koriki supports Mini Flip models; MinUI lists it as 'Legacy'. No KNULLI image available (checked KNULLI Scarab 2026-05-11 releases). Hardware specifications not sourced from verified vendor or community pages at the time of check.

homebrew.name: spruceOS
homebrew.firmware: Custom Python-based frontend on top of the Miyoo stock OS.
homebrew.summary: Custom frontend that runs on top of the stock OS on supported Miyoo devices.

compatibility.note: spruceOS lists the Miyoo Mini Flip with 'Stable' support status (checked 2026-10-29).

requirements: A compatible Miyoo Mini Flip unit.
A new branded microSD card (do NOT use the stock card).
warnings: spruceOS is a frontend, not a full OS replacement; it runs on top of the stock OS.

homebrew.name: Koriki
homebrew.firmware: Custom firmware written to a microSD card; one card boots all supported Miyoo Mini family models.
homebrew.summary: Custom firmware for the Miyoo Mini family, with Mini Flip-specific lid-sensor and headphone handling.

compatibility.note: Koriki's release notes name Mini Flip models (pause for lid-sensor issues, headphone detection) and describe one microSD card that auto-detects the device model (checked 2026-10-29).

requirements: A compatible Miyoo Mini Flip unit.
A new branded microSD card (do NOT use the stock card).
warnings: Koriki is installed on a microSD card; keep the stock card untouched so the device can return to stock.

homebrew.name: MinUI
homebrew.firmware: Custom launcher and libretro frontend on an SD card.
homebrew.summary: Focused custom launcher and libretro frontend; its supported-devices table lists the Miyoo Mini Flip as 'Legacy'.

compatibility.note: MinUI's supported-devices table lists 'Miyoo Mini Flip' (added MinUI-20251023-0) with status 'Legacy' (checked 2026-10-29).

requirements: A compatible Miyoo Mini Flip unit.
A new branded microSD card (do NOT use the stock card).
warnings: MinUI marks the Mini Flip's support as 'Legacy', meaning it will be retired in a future update.
